This is a senior-level software engineering role on Cloudflare's Zero Trust team, focused specifically on Windows development for the Zero Trust desktop client — an endpoint agent that routes corporate device traffic to Cloudflare's network for web filtering and policy enforcement. The work is primarily Rust alongside platform-native languages and APIs, writing high-performance cross-platform networking code, with incidental exposure to Swift, C#, C, and Python. It leans heavily on Windows internals and kernel-mode programming, low-level network driver development, multithreaded and asynchronous code, and networking protocols such as TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, QUIC, and HTTP/3.
